spellbook.finance/limitations: An order group's acquisitionSource starts with ORDER#. A precon deck group's starts with PRECON#.
A group leaves this list once it is received. An empty list means nothing is pending, not that nothing was bought.

description: Read what a workspace has bought or saved that has not arrived yet, one group per marketplace order or precon deck import. Each group carries its acquisitionSource, a readable title, the copy and card counts, the total cost, the date it was recorded and the bins its copies are assigned to. Call this to answer what is still on the way, or to find the acquisitionSource to receive. It reports pending groups; it does not track a package or say when one will arrive.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose incoming inventory to read, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_inventory_incoming
